subject: HEAVY RELEASE compute + DELTA13 READY: n2mb_render_targets v3 MSAA; 83/83 release+ASan
body:
HEAVY RELEASE compute. DELTA13 complete for render's MSAA R2 ABI.

ABI in metal/nord2_metal_bridge.h (source hashes below):
#define N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_MSAA_VERSION 3u
struct n2mb_resolve_target { uint64_t token,offset,length; uint32_t format,row_bytes,width,height,reserved; };
struct n2mb_render_targets { ...existing targets,blends...; const uint32_t *sample_counts; const struct n2mb_resolve_target *resolves; };
Version1/2 semantics and emitted packets unchanged.

Render contract: v3 sample_counts[count] required, all 1 or 4; target spans row*height*samples; resolves NULL or count entries with token0=none. Nonzero resolve requires sample4, format 0 or exact target format, exact q width/height, 64B row/address alignment, offset<=length<=BO, non-alias with every target and earlier resolve. Bridge looks up/retains target+resolve BOs with write=1; no raw resolve address accepted. v3 blends optional; NULL keeps shared blend. n2r owns sample LUT/fb pattern/writeback_msaa/AVERAGE resolve fields.

TESTS: python3 workers/compute/check_mrt_bridge.py release then one ASan/UBSan: 83 checks, 0 required each. New v3 cases: 4x+2 resolves (fb sample4/ROTATED_4X_GRID, AVERAGE resolve VA/row, LAYERED no-resolve, LUT, target+resolve retained write), sample4/sample1 no-resolve, and refusals for NULL/mixed counts, sample1+resolve, format/width mismatch, target/resolve alias, short resolve span. v1/v2 legacy identity green.
